rationale: The plan matches the reference: PyDESeq2 Wald test on rounded Salmon counts with design ~condition, control as explicit reference, treated-vs-control contrast, median-of-ratios size factors inside the model, and a minimal >=10-in-6-samples pre-filter tied to the smallest group. QC precedes the fit with library sizes, top-500 VST PCA, and a distance heatmap, and sample_01 is kept with a stated keep/drop policy plus a sensitivity refit rather than being dropped for depth alone. BH at 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm-style shrinkage with a stated fallback, and a p-value histogram check are all explicit; the only ambiguity is a listed 'test_against_threshold' policy without a stated LFC threshold. Enrichment uses gseapy prerank on the full Wald-statistic-ranked list, Hallmark 2026.1 named, 15-500 window, seed recorded, unmapped share reported, and the report specifies versions, counts, diagnostics, and design caveats including the lost length offset.
